description: Na₄ZrAlSi₂PO₁₂ crystallizes in the monoclinic Cc space group. There are four inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.35-2.91 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.42-2.95 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.39-2.97 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted hexagonal planar geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.42-2.71 Å. Zr is bonded to six O atoms to form ZrO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra and corners with four SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Zr-O bond distances ranging from 2.01-2.14 Å. Al is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted AlO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra and corners with four SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Al-O bond distances ranging from 1.85-2.24 Å. There are two inequivalent Si sites. In the first Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent ZrO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent AlO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 28-37°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.63-1.65 Å. In the second Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent ZrO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent AlO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 25-37°. There are two shorter (1.64 Å) and two longer (1.65 Å) Si-O bond lengths. P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent ZrO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent AlO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 30-36°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.54-1.56 Å. There are twelve inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Al, and one P atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to two equivalent Na, one Al, and one Si atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Al, and one Si atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Zr, and one Si atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Zr, and one Si atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to two Na, one Zr, and one P atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded to three Na, one Al, and one Si atom to form distorted ONa₃AlSi trigonal bipyramids that share corners with three ONa₃ZrSi trigonal bipyramids,  an edgeedge with one ONa₃ZrSi trigonal bipyramid, and  a faceface with one ONa₃AlSi trigonal bipyramid. In the eighth O site, O is bonded to three Na, one Al, and one Si atom to form distorted ONa₃AlSi trigonal bipyramids that share corners with four ONa₃ZrSi trigonal bipyramids,  an edgeedge with one ONa₃ZrSi trigonal bipyramid, and  a faceface with one ONa₃AlSi trigonal bipyramid. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Al, and one P atom. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Zr, and one P atom. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded to three Na, one Zr, and one Si atom to form distorted ONa₃ZrSi trigonal bipyramids that share corners with three ONa₃AlSi trigonal bipyramids,  an edgeedge with one ONa₃AlSi trigonal bipyramid, and  a faceface with one ONa₃ZrSi trigonal bipyramid. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded to three Na, one Zr, and one Si atom to form distorted ONa₃ZrSi trigonal bipyramids that share corners with four ONa₃AlSi trigonal bipyramids,  an edgeedge with one ONa₃AlSi trigonal bipyramid, and  a faceface with one ONa₃ZrSi trigonal bipyramid.
